description: Compile a task brief BEFORE starting substantial work — pin down the goal (what "done" looks like), context, constraints (standing rules included automatically) and tooling — confirm with the user, then execute against it. Asks at most 2-3 clarifying questions, only where the answer would change the output; otherwise states assumptions in the brief and proceeds. Use when the user says "brief this task", "scope this properly", "what do you need from me", "improve my prompt", "help me get better output", or hands over a SUBSTANTIAL task — multi-step, multi-document, or a deliverable someone else will read — as a thin one-line request. Not for quick one-step asks — answer those directly.
